name: derivative_tangent
description: Show a function with an animating tangent line and its slope value.

func.description: Function expression in Python syntax, e.g. "np.sin(x)" or "x**2"

code:
from manim import *
import math
from math import pi


def _smart_text(text, font_size):
    """含非 ASCII 字符（中文/希腊字母/全角符号）用 Text（Pango 渲染，支持中文）；纯 ASCII 用 MathTex（LaTeX 渲染，支持数学公式）。"""
    return Text(text, font_size=font_size) if any(ord(c) > 127 for c in text) else MathTex(text, font_size=font_size)


class DerivativeTangentScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        expr = {{func}}
        x0 = {{point}}
        title_text = {{title}}

        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-6, 6, 1],
            y_range=[-4, 4, 1],
            axis_config={"include_numbers": True, "font_size": 18},
        ).scale(0.9)
        self.play(Create(axes))

        f = lambda x: eval(expr, {"__builtins__": {}}, {"x": x, "np": np, "math": math, "pi": pi})
        graph = axes.plot(f, color=YELLOW)
        self.play(Create(graph))

        # 数值导数
        h = 1e-6
        slope = (f(x0 + h) - f(x0 - h)) / (2 * h)
        y0 = f(x0)
        point = axes.coords_to_point(x0, y0)
        dot = Dot(point, color=RED)

        def tangent_line(x):
            return y0 + slope * (x - x0)

        tangent = axes.plot(tangent_line, color=GREEN)
        self.play(Create(dot))
        self.play(Create(tangent))

        slope_text = MathTex(r"f'(" + str(x0) + r") = ", round(slope, 4), font_size=40).to_corner(UL)
        self.play(Write(slope_text))

        if title_text:
            title = _smart_text(title_text, font_size=44).to_edge(UP)
            self.play(Write(title))

        self.wait(2)

ui.label: 导数与切线
ui.description: 展示函数在某点的切线，并自动计算该点导数

fields.label: 切点 x 坐标
fields.hint: 曲线在该点的切线会被标出
